meta.title: Workspace Sections
meta.description: Unofficial community plugin: it patch-builds the MIT-licensed official @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace browser bundle (the shipped package itself is never modified) to split the sidebar workspace list into Active / Session tasks / Inactive sections. Official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop are reused as-is; switch back to the shipped list from View options, or disable the plugin in Settings. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
